# lgd-skill-marketplace

> LGD Skill Marketplace — one-stop AI skill catalog. Enter from any skill.

## Skills

- Skill Skeleton Generator: https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/skill-skeleton-generator (AI工程, 88/100, recommended: Create a new LGD-compliant AI skill skeleton)
- Prompt Injection Guard: https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/prompt-injection-guard (安全, 86/100, recommended: Scan text/files for prompt injection & secrets before use)
- Context Token Budget: https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/context-token-budget (效率, 84/100, recommended: Guard AI context before overspending tokens)
- Silent Failure Scanner: https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/silent-failure-scanner (质量, 85/100, recommended: Catch silent AI failures before shipping)
- Badge Studio: https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/badge-studio (设计, 85/100, recommended: Generate ORCID-style LGD VERIFIED badges)
- LLMs.txt Generator: https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/llms-generator (效率, 85/100, recommended: Make any project AI-discoverable (llms.txt))
- Skill Quality Gate: https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/skill-quality-gate (质量, 89/100, recommended: Pre-release health check for AI skills)
- Skill Registry: https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/skill-registry (治理, 88/100, recommended: Single source of truth for skill collections)
- Skill Scorecard (four-angle): https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/skill-scorecard (治理, 91/100, recommended: Four-angle audit REG/TRUST/SAFE/MACH of any repo)
- LGD Guardrails (agent loop guard): https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/lgd-guardrails (安全, 91/100, recommended: Stop runaway agent loops (step/repeat/stuck))
